questions.prompt: Which conflict is often called the war to end all wars?
questions.fact: The phrase came from a book by H.G. Wells and was already being used sarcastically within a decade.

questions.prompt: What is the largest structure in the human skeleton by volume?
questions.fact: It fuses from three separate bones during adolescence, which is why a child's is more flexible than an adult's.

questions.prompt: What is a perfect score in Olympic gymnastics under the old scoring system?
questions.fact: The scoreboard could not display it the first time it was achieved in 1976, so it showed 1.00 instead.

questions.prompt: Which instrument is Jimi Hendrix most associated with?
questions.fact: He played right-handed instruments upside down, restringing them, which changed the tone in ways guitarists still chase.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest sea entirely within one country's borders?
questions.fact: It sits wholly within Turkey and links the Black Sea to the Aegean through two narrow straits.

questions.prompt: Which Russian author wrote the short story The Overcoat?
questions.fact: A famous remark holds that all Russian literature came out from under this one coat.

options: The smallest element of a digital image
questions.fact: The word is a contraction of picture element, and modern phone screens pack them tighter than the eye can resolve.
